title: Display each project's running allocation share
description: You turn choice indices into project-specific selection indicators.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create a figure and visit every project index. sel becomes one when the chosen project equals a and zero otherwise.
You pass each indicator sequence to running_mean and plot the result. The legend labels each curve with names[a].

steps.question: Do these calls use the helper's default window?
steps.answer: They explicitly pass w, overriding the default for every result label.

steps.description: You display a separate running-share chart for each stored strategy. The vertical label identifies the share in the recent window of rounds.
